The [[Nalroni/Legends|Nalroni]] '''Weezo''' ran [[Weezo's Gun Shop]], a personal armament store which was located in the market of the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[StarForge Station]]. Scarred and forced to wear an [[Eye patch/Legends|eye patch]]<ref name="Orbit" /> by [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{FarOrbitDate}}</ref> Weezo specialized in [[Starship/Legends|ship]]-board weapons, and her prices were double list price, though that was considered normal on StarForge Station. The [[Merchant/Legends|storeowner]] allowed customers to try out her goods in a weapons range situated at the back of her shop. After putting the weapons in the range room, Weezo would allow the customer in, and would not let them out until they used up the small amount of ammunition. As her store did not supply [[Armor/Legends|armor]], she referred customers who were looking for that to [[Just Armor]], another store in the market.<ref name="Orbit" />

==Behind the scenes==
Weezo first appeared in "[[Preparing for War]]," an adventure scenario from [[1998]]'s ''[[The Far Orbit Project]]'', a supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' written by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]].<ref name="Orbit" />
